Bathroom Remodeling in Maize, KS

Maize's housing wave of the early 2000s through 2015 produced a lot of builder-grade bathrooms — and they're all aging in the same way at the same time. The fiberglass tub surrounds that were standard in Maize's Reflection Lakes, Quail Ridge, and Copper Creek subdivisions were factory-made, installed in a day, and designed to look fine for 10 years. At year 20, they're crazed, yellowed, and impossible to keep clean regardless of how much bathroom cleaner you apply. The cultured marble vanity tops have hairline cracks that won't seal. The exhaust fan is underpowered and probably doesn't actually vent outside properly.

These bathrooms haven't failed in a way that requires emergency repairs. They've just reached the point where remodeling them from scratch is a better investment than another round of cleaning, caulking, and pretending they're adequate.

Wheatland Construction remodels bathrooms in Maize and northwest Sedgwick County. We're a Veterans Approved Builder (ID: 00899), Home Advisor Certified since 2019, and family-owned since 2018. Maize's subdivisions are a regular part of our work area.

What Maize Bathroom Remodels Typically Look Like

The most common Maize bathroom remodel scope:

Primary bath walk-in shower conversion: Demo the original fiberglass tub/shower combo, frame a walk-in shower to the footprint of the existing alcove, apply Schluter Kerdi or equivalent membrane waterproofing, install large-format porcelain tile (12x24 or larger), frameless glass panel or door, built-in niche, updated shower fixtures. This is the most-requested scope in Maize's 2000s primary baths.

Vanity and top replacement: New vanity cabinet, quartz countertop with undermount sink, new faucet and drain. The cultured marble integral-sink tops that came standard in early 2000s Maize homes don't age gracefully. Quartz is the replacement standard.

Full primary bath renovation: Shower conversion + new vanity + new toilet + new lighting + new exhaust fan vented properly to exterior. Complete transformation.

Hall bath tub/shower refresh: Keep the tub but tile the surround — 3-wall tub surround in porcelain, new fixtures, new vanity.

Moisture and Waterproofing in Maize

Maize's northwest Wichita drainage corridor gets significant sump pump activity in wet years, and the moisture conditions below grade translate to higher-than-average humidity in bathrooms on main and upper floors in homes with basement moisture events. Proper exhaust ventilation and membrane waterproofing in shower installations are more important here than in drier locations. We don't use caulk-and-cement-board as a waterproofing system — we use membranes.

Permits in Maize

Bathroom remodels with plumbing or electrical work permit through City of Maize or Sedgwick County depending on address. We determine jurisdiction and handle all permits.

Frequently Asked Questions About Bathroom Remodeling in Maize

How much does bathroom remodeling cost in Maize, KS?

Maize bathroom remodels range from $8,000 for a basic refresh to $25,000+ for a full primary bath renovation with walk-in shower conversion, new vanity, and updated electrical. Full primary bath with shower conversion, new vanity, and lighting typically runs $14,000–$22,000. Written, line-item estimates.

Do I need permits for bathroom remodeling in Maize?

Plumbing and electrical work requires permits. We determine whether City of Maize or Sedgwick County is the correct jurisdiction for your address and handle all permit work.

How long does a Maize bathroom remodel take?

2–4 weeks for most projects. Full primary bath conversions with custom tile work may run 3–5 weeks.

Should I convert my Maize primary bath tub to a walk-in shower?

In Maize's 2000s homes, if the primary bath's tub is the only tub in the house, a walk-in shower conversion reduces resale marketability for buyers with young children. If there's a second tub in the home, the conversion is the right call for your daily quality of life and adds appeal for buyers 40+. We discuss this at the consultation.

What's the best tile choice for a Maize bathroom remodel?

Porcelain tile in large format (12x24 or 24x24) for shower walls and floors. It's durable, doesn't require sealing, and reads as premium compared to the small-format tile common in the original Maize builder bathrooms. We show you current options at the consultation.

Does bathroom remodeling add value in the Maize school district?

Yes. Maize USD 266 drives buyer demand. Updated bathrooms — particularly a walk-in tile shower in the primary bath — are a meaningful differentiator in the northwest Wichita suburban market. They return well in appraised value and improve days-on-market.
